allocation_model.meaning: Conditional initial chunks and module setup reuse; excludes controller overhead, work stealing and future variance; not timing qualification
allocation_model.planning_score_rule: Ceiling to whole seconds of the largest coherent phase path plus its observed maximum phase-to-supervisor role residual; planning only, not a timing bound or qualification; raw scores can regress within rounded buckets
allocation_model.planning_score_scope: Eight complete cohorts only; active known-scope scores and explicit unknowns are separate in scoped_allocation.shards

calibration.role: Historical planning observations; not a complete passing profile or current performance

scoped_allocation.meaning: Mirror first, then descending execution weights and strictly improving whole-selector moves; all eight complete cohorts still cover the frozen shard. The partial observations never alter ordinary dispatch costs or approval limits.
scoped_allocation.role: Partial known-scope stress only; null means unknown, never zero or imputed
